integrity: The foundational 1999 article was checked for the exact equations, classic parameters, and day-resolved publication date. The complete author-hosted 2000 same-object bifurcation article was inspected across its construction, mathematical-properties, equilibrium-bifurcation, periodic-bifurcation, chaotic-attractor, comparison, and conclusion sections; targeted term checks found no matching conditional-expectation or variance theorem. A same-object 2004 mathematical record was checked for primary MSC 34C23 ownership. A published complex-Chen stationary-balance result was read at full statement and proof level; its real specialization yields integrated balances but not the accepted three fiberwise regressions. The three conditional laws, speed defects, covariance identities, and equality cases were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not establish existence or uniqueness of a physical measure.
It does not determine entropy, Lyapunov exponents, fractal dimension, basin geometry, or the full invariant density.
Equilibrium-supported mixtures can have nonzero coordinate variance while all three coordinate-speed defects vanish.
Integrated real-subspace balances already supplied by a published complex-Chen stationary-balance result are treated as prior coverage.
A differently phrased equivalent fiberwise observation could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Three fiberwise stationary regressions and speed-coherence laws in the Chen flow
